description: Stereo emulation of channel B of the Randall RG100 guitar preamp, ported from Valdemar Erlingsson's VST, with a CV input for every knob

params.text: Takes the distortion out of the signal path, so the input passes straight to the output
How much low frequency the tone stack passes
How much middle frequency the tone stack passes
How much high frequency the tone stack passes
Switches the boost in and out
Sets the level of the signal entering the preamp
Sets how hard the preamp is driven
Sets the level of the signal leaving the preamp
How much of the voltage at the BASS CV input reaches the BASS setting
How much of the voltage at the MID CV input reaches the MID setting
How much of the voltage at the TREBLE CV input reaches the TREBLE setting
How much of the voltage at the PRESENCE CV input reaches the PRESENCE setting
How much of the voltage at the INPUT CV input reaches the INPUT setting
How much of the voltage at the GAIN CV input reaches the GAIN setting
How much of the voltage at the VOLUME CV input reaches the VOLUME setting

inputs.text: The left side of the stereo input
The right side of the stereo input
A trigger switches the bypass on and off
A trigger switches the boost on and off
A voltage moving the BASS setting

The right side of the stereo output
